content:
**Crispy flying ant bits** is an unused consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Pieces of flying ant meat that have been cooked over fire. They restore a small amount of HP and AP and satisfy a moderate amount of hunger at the cost of a negligible dose of rads.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Flying ant meat (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Flying ant meat | | Crispy flying ant bits (1) | 

Although this item can be found in game files, it is not obtainable in game.
